regime_context: The detector shows a broad but shallow leadership structure: only 8 of 16 themes are trend-eligible, with no one-narrative dominance (absorption 0.31). Momentum ranks are a focus lens, not alpha; the one validated edge is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control, which is active for eligible names. Cross-sectional rank-IC is weak, so directional calls must lean on structure and durability, not rank.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Big Banks closes the rotation margin gap versus Oil & Gas Producers (currently 0.868 score difference) with a simultaneous durability_bar rise above 0.75 — that observable combination would retire the watch; until then, treat banks as a challenger only, not a confirmed leadership handoff.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The leader holds rank 1 with the only positive score above 1, is trend-eligible, and shows decent breadth (0.571) with no crowding. However, its durability bar is middling (0.55) and hurst_tag mean-revert suggests choppy follow-through. The trend-gate leg supports staying involved; direction is a modest lean, not a forecast.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag and only moderate durability imply the leadership could stall or rotate quickly; energy exposure is vulnerable to a macro surprise given unscheduled_share=1.0 in the narrative flow.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its 20-day moving average for three consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Rank 2, eligible, with the strongest durability (0.72) and highest breadth (0.857) of the top quartile, plus a trend hurst_tag. The rotation margin vs the leader is sizable (0.868) but not a confirmed handoff; banks represent a steadier trend structure rather than momentum. The trend-gate leg is the main support.
theses.dissent: The challenger label does not imply an imminent overtake; financials could underperform if rate/credit conditions shift, and the moderate score leaves little momentum cushion against mean reversion in the sector.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 3% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Eligible, high durability (0.79), strong breadth (0.833), trend tag, and negative crowding_z (-0.37, uncrowded). The score is near zero, but the trend-gate leg favors staying in high-durability, uncrowded trends as a defensive anchor. This is a structural lean, not a momentum call.
theses.dissent: Score is barely positive (0.007), so there is no relative strength behind the trend; if the broad market rolls over, utilities may lag a cyclical rebound and the low momentum could translate into underperformance.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO breaks below its 60-day moving average before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
